title: [FEATURE] - Add Setting to Disable Automatic IDE Selection Context
body:
### Preflight Checklist - [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet - [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features) ### Problem Statement

Feature Request: Add Setting to Disable Automatic IDE Selection Context

Problem

When using Claude Code in VS Code/Cursor, any text selected in the editor is automatically included in every message's context. While this is useful for "explain this code" scenarios, it becomes problematic in longer sessions where:

  1. You selected something earlier for a one-time question
  2. You moved on to unrelated tasks
  3. The selection persists across new conversation windows
  4. You're now paying tokens for irrelevant context on every single message

Concrete Example
